draft.subject: Next step for Lantern Labs in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week and sending an invite out. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding your real tasks to that project is usually what makes everything else click.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and walk through that first project with you, or just answer anything by email.

Best,
Nadia
